_readme: Corrections applied on top of the Google Sheet every time scripts/fetch-news.js runs.
This file wins over the sheet, so the site can be fixed here without edit access to it.
Titles are matched exactly, ignoring case and extra spaces.
suppress — titles to drop from the site entirely.
images   — replace a row's image with a file committed in this repo.
extra    — posts that are not in the sheet at all. Supports body[] for
paragraphs and gallery[] for extra photos below the body.
Delete an entry to hand control of that post back to the sheet.

extra.title: Successful Youth Trial at Azaadville – Players Selected for GDL & DDC Pathways
extra.excerpt: Our scouts Tshidiso Frans Motingoe and Rodan Pillay ran an open trial for players aged 11–21 at Azaadville, with several players already offered contracts.
body: We recently hosted a highly successful open trial for young footballers aged 11–21 at Azaadville, Krugersdorp. The session was conducted by our scouts Tshidiso Frans Motingoe and Rodan Pillay, who carefully assessed talent across the age groups.

The trial delivered excellent results. Many players stood out and were selected, with a number already receiving contract offers from DD Sports Management. This marks an exciting step forward for these young athletes as they take the next step in their development journeys.
What’s next?

• A large group of the selected players will be placed with DDC teams.
• A training game has already been arranged to continue their preparation and evaluation.
• Some players will also have the opportunity to feature at GDL level.
• All placements are scheduled to be finalised by Monday, 19 October.

We are proud of the standard shown by every player who attended and remain committed to creating clear pathways into competitive environments. Congratulations to all those selected — the hard work starts now.
Keep following our updates for further news on player placements and upcoming opportunities.

extra.title: Introducing Mr Tshidiso Frans Motingoe – Our New Scout
extra.excerpt: We are excited to welcome Mr Tshidiso Frans Motingoe to the D.D Sports Management Agency team as a Scout, working alongside Chief Scout Rodan Pillay.
body: We are excited to welcome Mr Tshidiso Frans Motingoe to the D.D Sports Management Agency team!

Tshidiso joins us as a Scout and will work closely alongside our Chief Scout, Rodan Pillay. With more than nine years of experience in the industry, he brings valuable knowledge and a sharp eye for talent.
His primary focus will be identifying and scouting promising local grassroots players as well as LFA players, helping us continue building a strong pipeline of young talent.
We look forward to the positive impact Tshidiso will make as we grow together.
Please join us in giving him a warm welcome to the D.D Sports Management Agency family!

extra.title: Mpho “Tyson” Maila Is Here!
extra.excerpt: We’re delighted to announce the signing of 19-year-old centre-back Mpho Maila, a Mamelodi Sundowns Academy product now with Lamontville Golden Arrows.
body: We’re delighted to announce the signing of exciting young central defender Mpho Maila.

Born in Pretoria on 8 February 2007, the 19-year-old centre-back arrives with a strong foundation and clear upward trajectory. A product of the renowned Mamelodi Sundowns Academy, Maila has already shown the composure, physical presence and defensive instincts that mark out players who can go far in the professional game.

Most recently he has been sharpening his craft at Lamontville Golden Arrows, where he featured regularly for the Diski side and made his debut in September 2025. Known as “Tyson” among teammates, he brings energy, commitment and a no-nonsense approach to defending that supporters will quickly come to appreciate.

At just 19, Maila still has significant room to grow, but the foundations are already solid: good reading of the game, a willingness to put his body on the line, and the technical grounding that comes from one of South Africa’s elite development systems. We believe this is the right environment for him to take the next step and push for regular first-team football.
Welcome to the family, Mpho. The hard work starts now — and we can’t wait to see you in our colours.

extra.title: The Congolese Super Striker Finds the Back of the Net!
extra.excerpt: Laudry Mukaba has opened his account for Sua Flamingoes with his first Botswana Premier League goal — a clinical finish and the first of many.
body: Laudry Mukaba has opened his account for the Flamingoes with his first league goal — and the celebrations are fully underway.

The powerful Congolese forward, who joined Sua Flamingoes after previous stints including African Stars, delivered the moment fans had been waiting for. With a clinical finish that showcased his sharp movement and composure in the box, Mukaba finally got his name on the scoresheet in the Botswana Premier League.

It’s a special milestone for the 24-year-old striker. Every player remembers their first goal in new colours, and this one carries extra weight as he continues to settle into life with the Flamingoes. The goal is not just a personal landmark — it’s a boost for the team and a clear signal that Mukaba is starting to hit his stride.

We couldn’t be happier for him. From the first training sessions to match days, his work rate and hunger have been plain to see. Now the hard work has been rewarded with that all-important first league strike.
Here’s to many more, Laudry. Keep hunting, keep scoring, and keep lighting up the pitch for the Flamingoes. The best is still ahead.
Congolese fire. Flamingo pride. First of many.

extra.title: Injury Update: Jacob Everson Out 8–10 Weeks
extra.excerpt: Jacob Everson has suffered a fracture to his left foot and will be out of action for 8–10 weeks.
body: Jacob Everson has suffered a fracture to his left foot and will be out of action for 8–10 weeks.
The entire team and community stand behind him. We’re wishing Jacob a full and speedy recovery — and we know the comeback will be greater than the setback.
Get well soon, Jacob. We’ll be ready when you are.

extra.title: Welcome Azeez Falolu to the D.D Sports Management Family!
extra.excerpt: D.D Sports Management Agency is proud to announce a new partnership with NPFL midfield dynamo Azeez Falolu, the 22-year-old Enugu Rangers midfielder.
body: D.D Sports Management Agency is proud to announce an exciting new partnership, officially joining forces with one of Nigerian football’s most promising talents, midfield dynamo Azeez Falolu.

Falolu is a highly gifted 22-year-old central midfielder known across the Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL) for his incredible work rate, tactical vision, and relentless energy. After establishing himself as a standout performer for Katsina United, his rising profile caught the attention of the reigning NPFL champions, Enugu Rangers, who secured his signature in August 2026. Capable of dictating play or disrupting opposition attacks, he made an immediate impression with a dominant performance during his competitive debut for the Flying Antelopes.

At D.D Sports Management Agency, our mission is to provide the elite support system and global network necessary to turn raw potential into world-class success. Falolu already possesses the grit, intelligence, and hunger to succeed. Together, we look forward to unlocking international opportunities, elevating his career, and taking his immense talents all the way to the stars.
Welcome to the family, Azeez!

extra.title: D.D Sports Management Agency Signs Exciting Nigerian Prospect Taofeek Otaniyi
extra.excerpt: D.D Sports Management Agency is delighted to announce the signing of talented young Nigerian midfielder Taofeek Otaniyi.
body: D.D Sports Management Agency is delighted to announce the signing of talented young Nigerian midfielder Taofeek Otaniyi.
The 19-year-old star has been one of the standout performers in the NPFL over the past two seasons, combining strong domestic form with CAF Champions League experience and a senior Nigeria call-up.

A dynamic central midfielder with excellent energy, technical quality and composure on the ball, Otaniyi represents the type of high-upside African talent the agency specialises in developing and guiding toward bigger stages.
We look forward to working closely with Taofeek as he continues his rapid rise and takes the next steps in his professional career.

extra.title: DONE DEAL: Aristote Tamuzi Joins Asante Kotoko on Two-Year Contract
extra.excerpt: Asante Kotoko have completed the signing of Congolese defender Aristote Tamuzi on an initial two-year contract, with an option for a further season.
body: Asante Kotoko have officially completed the signing of talented defender Aristote Tamuzi.
The Congolese center back joins the Porcupine Warriors on an initial two-year contract, with an option to extend for a further season.

Tamuzi arrives in Kumasi to reinforce the squad's defensive options ahead of the new campaign. Known for his robust defending, athletic work rate, and ability to contribute effectively in transition, the Congolese player is expected to bring immediate quality and top-flight experience to the backline.

Club management expressed immense satisfaction with the successful negotiation, noting that Tamuzi's profile perfectly aligns with the technical team's vision for a resilient, high-energy squad. The player has successfully completed his medical examinations and is expected to join his new teammates for pre-season training immediately.
Everyone at the club welcomes Aristote to Kumasi and wishes him a highly successful tenure in the famous red jersey.
Fabukay! Wo Kum Apem a, Apem Beba!

extra.title: Welcome Naledi Kgobe to the D.D Sports Management Family!
extra.excerpt: We're excited to officially welcome Naledi Kgobe from the Mamelodi Sundowns F.C. Academy to the D.D Sports Management family!
body: We're excited to officially welcome Naledi Kgobe from the prestigious Mamelodi Sundowns F.C. Academy to D.D Sports Management Agency!

Coming through one of South Africa's strongest development pipelines, Naledi represents the next generation of talent with the potential to go far. We're proud to partner with this rising star and look forward to supporting his journey every step of the way.
Welcome to the family, Naledi! The future is bright — let's build it together.

extra.title: Welcome Aristote Tamuzi to the D.D Sports Management Family!
extra.excerpt: We're thrilled to officially welcome centre-back Aristote Tamuzi to the D.D Sports Management family!
body: We're thrilled to officially welcome Aristote Tamuzi (Aristote Ntangu Tamuzi) to D.D Sports Management Agency!

The 26-year-old centre-back from Kinshasa, DR Congo (born 13 August 1999), stands tall at 1.88m and brings solid defensive quality, composure, and experience from his time with Mbabane Highlanders and AS New Soger.
We're excited to partner with Aristote and support him as he continues to develop and reach new heights in his career. The journey continues — and we're here every step of the way.
Welcome to the family, Aristote! Let's go to work.

extra.title: Deal Locked In! Rayhan El Grafel Signs Two-Year Deal with RWDM
extra.excerpt: Rayhan El Grafel has signed a two-year deal with RWDM, stepping up from Beerschot U21 as the Belgian side push for promotion.
body: Deal locked in! Rayhan El Grafel has officially signed a two-year deal with RWDM.
After a dominant stint with Beerschot U21, the rising star is heading to the Belgian third division.
RWDM are hunting hard for promotion after an unfortunate relegation, and El Grafel is exactly the weapon they need to fight their way back to the top.
Remember the name: El Grafel. Huge potential for greatness. The journey starts now!

extra.title: Remember the Name: Samuel Tabares Signs for Gillingham FC
extra.excerpt: Young defender Samuel Tabares has signed for Gillingham FC after development years at Fulham U21 and Southampton U21.
body: Remember the name: Samuel Tabares.
The highly talented young defender has officially put pen to paper with Gillingham FC.
Following impressive development years at Fulham U21 and Southampton U21, this move to League Two is the perfect launchpad for his senior career.
With his sights firmly set on a future in the Premier League, there is no doubt he is on the path to greatness.

extra.title: Liberian Marksman on the Move! Rufus Sackie Jr Joins African Stars
extra.excerpt: Rufus Sackie Jr has completed his transfer to Namibian giants African Stars F.C., bringing 49 goal contributions in 63 games to the Namibian top flight.
body: Liberian marksman on the move! Rufus Sackie Jr has officially completed his transfer to Namibian giants African Stars F.C. ahead of their massive CAF Champions League campaign.
With an incredible record of 41 goals and 8 assists in just 63 games, the Liberian international is primed to take the Namibian top flight by storm.
But the club level isn't his only target — Rufus has his eyes firmly set on representing Liberia at the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
Welcome our new marksman to D.D Sports Management Agency.

extra.title: The Congolese Sniper Is Locked and Loaded
extra.excerpt: Ten goal contributions in just eight pre-season games — Laudry Mukaba is locked and loaded ahead of a massive season with Sua Flamingoes.
body: The Congolese Sniper is locked and loaded.
Laudry Mukaba is absolutely tearing up the pre-season. Ten goal contributions in just eight games is an unbelievable stat line for the young international.
The hard work is paying off and this is only the beginning of a massive season ahead. Remember the name.

extra.title: The Big Move Is Confirmed! Lyema Dopolo Joins African Stars
extra.excerpt: Lyema Dopolo is officially a Namibia Giant — the defender is en route to African Stars F.C. ahead of their CAF Champions League campaign.
body: The big move is confirmed! Lyema Dopolo is officially a Namibia Giant, en route to African Stars F.C.
Lyema is taking his game to the absolute highest level in African football as the team gears up for the CAF Champions League.
African Stars have been drawn against AS Mangasport in the first preliminary round, with the tie scheduled for 4–6 September 2026.
Big stage. Big ambitions. Ready to shine.

extra.title: Jacob Everson Joins BDF XI
extra.excerpt: Jacob Everson has finalised a season-long loan move to BDF XI in the Botswana Premier Division.
body: We can confirm that Jacob Everson has finalised a season-long loan move to BDF XI in the Botswana Premier Division.
We are excited to see Jacob gain valuable first-team minutes and continue his development on the big stage. Go get 'em, Jacob.

extra.title: Zungu Out!
extra.excerpt: D.D Sports Management Agency has terminated Lindokuhle Zungu's contract with the agency, effective immediately.
body: D.D Sports Management Agency has terminated Lindokuhle Zungu's contract with the agency, effective immediately.
Dontè Dorlly: "Success does not change who you are; it only reveals it. You traded our loyalty for a quick win."

extra.title: Congolese Marksman Laudry Mukaba Inks New Deal!
extra.excerpt: Laudry Mukaba has signed a two-year contract with Sua Flamingoes, with an option for a further year, ahead of the Botswana Premier Division season.
body: We are pleased to announce that Laudry Mukaba has signed a two-year contract with Sua Flamingoes, with an option for an additional year.

We extend our best wishes to Laudry Mukaba for a successful season as he prepares to compete in the Botswana Premier Division. We anticipate that his exceptional goal-scoring abilities will be prominently displayed on this platform.
Laudry Mukaba's agent, Dontè Dorlly, provided the following statement:

"Discussions are currently underway with several prominent clubs interested in monitoring his performance this season. I have engaged in numerous conversations with clubs in Egypt, Algeria, and Morocco since the opening of the transfer window, highlighting his prolific goal-scoring record. While many clubs have expressed interest, the current lack of professional game experience has temporarily precluded his immediate integration into their squads.

Furthermore, his limited national team experience has impacted his progression. However, we anticipate that many teams will closely observe his performance this season, and should all go favorably, we foresee his transition to a more significant opportunity."

extra.title: Done Deal! Lindokuhle Zungu Puts Pen to Paper for the Ostriches
extra.excerpt: Lindokuhle Zungu has signed a 1+1 deal with Orapa United in the Botswana Premier Division.
body: Lindokuhle Zungu puts pen to paper for the Ostriches!
Zungu has signed a 1+1 deal with Orapa United in the Botswana Premier Division.
We extend our best wishes to Zungu for a successful season ahead.

extra.title: Project Concluded: Lyema Dopolo Completes His Season with Ongos F.C.
extra.excerpt: Lyema Dopolo closes his season at Ongos F.C. with 18 clean sheets in 30 matches, captaining the side to 4th place in the Namibian Premier Division.
body: Lyema Dopolo has successfully completed his season with Ongos F.C. in the Namibian Premier Division, delivering an exceptional performance that included 18 clean sheets across 30 matches.
He also led the team as captain to a commendable 4th place finish within the Namibian Premier Division.
Lyema's agent, Dontè Dorlly, expressed immense satisfaction with Lyema's consistent performance throughout the season.
It is unfortunate that no awards were presented, as Lyema garnered over 10 Man of the Match accolades. We anticipate a promising future for this talented individual.
Discussions were held with clubs in the Serbian Premier Division and Belgium; however, logistical constraints prevented his timely travel for evaluations.
We are currently engaged in ongoing discussions with interested clubs within Africa and anticipate finalizing a substantive opportunity for him in the near future.
